brightport_loudmouth.m: Hey kid, have you met my brother outside? Haha, that guy's a real scrooge. They say we're nothing alike. I'm telling you, he's just like mom - we'd ask her to tell us a bedtime story, and she'd have us pay for it with shiny stones or rainbow beetles. Hic. Speaking of bedtime stories...
r: I'm afraid if I let you speak it will never end.

brightport_loudmouth1.m: I once heard a story about a guy who visited a kingdom ruled by rats - They call it "Ratdom"! Haha! People say he disappeared as a child and reappeared a decade later, wearing clothes made entirely of ratskin. He even spoke Rattish! Imagine that, speaking Rattish! Hic. Speaking of rats...

brightport_loudmouth2.m: Those folks from Brimhaven! I'd refrain from rudely calling them ra... Mice. But if anyone resembles a mouse, it would be them. We got a job offer from... Hic. I'm professional enough not to reveal our clients... Long story short, we ended up declining due to a failure in negotiations. The client then went and hired some local, incompetent bunglers to handle the delicate job! Should've seen it coming, considering we wouldn't budge on the price. Speaking of price...
r: Interesting, but I must go now.

brightport_loudmouth3.m: Speaking of "never ending", I was assigned to a job a while ago, up in the north. On my way there, I encountered a small critter. Eager for some fresh meat, I slew it, but what came next was, quite literally, never ending. A whole group of large beasts were watching me as I was flaying the skin off the beast. Once I was distracted enough, they came pouring out of the bushes. I could maybe count a hundred before I went running! I left the meat behind, and even dropped my heirloom skinning knife. Speaking of knives...
r: Interesting, but I must go now.
